resources.string: Drag your finger over the screen to hear the choices, and lift it to choose.
Your screen reader can read the choices.
With the volume keys: volume down, next choice; volume up, previous choice; hold either key to choose. If your screen reader is silent, press volume up three times quickly.
The volume was very low, so I turned it up
The system voice is failing. I will go on with the rescue voice.
Something went wrong. Try another choice.
Closes the rescue. If safe mode turned your screen reader off and you have not turned one on, it turns it back on.
To go back to the rescue, tap the Back to the rescue button at the top right, or press volume up three times quickly.
To go back to the rescue, use the accessibility shortcut or open Accessible Rescue.
This phone does not have that screen. Try Accessibility settings.
Screen readers are off. The menu speaks with its own voice. If you touch nothing for %2$d seconds, %1$s comes back on.
Screen readers are off. The menu speaks with its own voice. If you touch nothing for %1$d seconds, your screen readers come back on.
Safe mode. No screen reader was on. The menu speaks with its own voice.
You have not touched anything. Turning your screen reader back on.
The rescue voice does not work, so I will not turn your screen reader off.
Turning your screen reader off needs the advanced permission. Meanwhile, use the volume keys.
Echo mode. I read with the rescue voice whatever your screen reader focuses. Use your usual gestures.
Attention: your screen reader has turned off. To open the rescue, press volume up three times quickly.
Attention: your screen reader is on but not responding. To open the rescue, press volume up three times quickly.
Attention: the system voice is not working. I will read the screen with the rescue voice. To open the rescue, press volume up three times quickly.
The system voice works again. I will stop reading with the rescue voice.
Yes. Volume up or tap here
No, cancel. Volume down or tap here
Open the rescue. Volume up or tap here
